user.title: Smart Led Messenger
user.description: The key is the one from your personal link, shown in your customer area under "Your personal URL": the value of the key parameter, copied exactly as it appears (including any %2B and %3D).

error.cle_invalide: The server rejected this key. Copy it again from your customer area, without adding or removing anything.
error.injoignable: The server did not answer. Check your internet access, then try again.

init.title: Tracked events
init.description: The entities you pick are announced on the display when their state changes: "Gate open", "Living room light on". The display has a single line, so tracking three or four beats tracking thirty.

data.intervalle_min: Minimum delay between two pushes from the same entity (seconds)

data_description.duree: After that, the event disappears on its own.
data_description.intervalle_min: Guards against a bouncing contact or a chatty sensor.
data_description.gabarits: One line per entity, as "entity_id: text". Available fields: {nom}, {etat}, {unite}. Example: binary_sensor.gate: The gate just moved

envoyer_evenement.name: Send an event
envoyer_evenement.description: Scrolls a text on the display for a few minutes, then lets it disappear.

envoyer_message.name: Send a permanent message
envoyer_message.description: Replaces the account's personal message and forces it on.

texte.name: Text
texte.description: The text to scroll. Empty clears the message.

effacer.name: Clear the current event
effacer.description: Removes the displayed event immediately, without waiting for it to expire.
